shortDescription: Moldova's central bank on Thursday hiked its key interest rate to 9% from 7.5%, the regulator's press service said.In August, the bank raised the rate by 0.5% to 7.5% to counter rising inflation.

children: Moldova's central bank on Thursday hiked its key interest rate to 9% from 7.5%, the regulator's press service said.
